name: Granada (Nicaragua)
summary: Granada is one of the oldest colonial cities in the Americas, with bright facades, a yellow cathedral and church bell towers to climb. Boat through the Isletas of Lake Nicaragua, peer into the glowing lava of Masaya Volcano at night, swim in Apoyo Lagoon and hike Mombacho's cloud forest.
seasonNote: Dry season December to April; green and wet May to November.
arrival: About 1 hour by road from Managua airport.
gettingAround: Walk the centre; horse carriages and taxis; shuttles to Masaya and Apoyo.
cashTip: Córdobas are used day to day, and US dollars are widely accepted. Carry small notes; change comes in córdobas.
foodTip: Vigorón, gallo pinto, quesillo and nacatamal.
buyTip: Masaya market hammocks and pottery from San Juan de Oriente.
